.qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml ([judge] block and mcp_servers, parsed with tomllib)
evidence: Isolated: task/task.toml:28 `environment_mode = "separate"`; task/environment/Dockerfile:14-15 copies only instructions/ and assets/ and installs no judge CLI or RewardKit, while task/tests/Dockerfile:43-44 copies /tests into the verifier image and removes group/other access. Credentialed: task/task.toml:30-35 is `REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code"`, `REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx"`, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api"`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`. Scripted comparison: everything from `[verifier]` to end of file is byte-equal to the frozen template task.toml, and the five env lines equal the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md:66-71; no CRLF; no live secret, only the ${VAR} template. task.toml:22 and :38 are `network_mode = "public"`; no allowed_hosts, docker_image or allow_internet keys (correct for this profile). Judge files: all five judge.toml have `judge = "claude-code"` at line 2 (expected fallback); tomllib parse of each [judge] table yields only judge, mode, timeout, isolated, prompt_template and mcp_servers - no model, reasoning_effort, temperature or weight key in any [judge] table. The `weight =` lines found by the deterministic-checks.md:81 grep are all inside [[criterion]] tables, which the contract allows. Pinned: task/tests/Dockerfile:17-21 pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1; line 31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; Chromium comes from the pinned Playwright MCP's bundled CLI (lines 33-35). task/tests/Dockerfile sha256 72998ab8...a55fdd is identical to the template's, so it is the unchanged template-controlled file. Observation, not a task defect: the bases at lines 1-2 (`node:22-bookworm-slim`, `python:3.12-slim`) are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned, and apt packages at lines 12-13 are unversioned; this is the shared template's own pinning level and the task must not edit it. Counterexample search: a task that swapped the judge model would have to do so either in [verifier.env] (byte-equal, so not present) or in a judge.toml [judge] table (parsed, not present); a conforming task cannot fail this row for public network or the claude-code fallback, and neither is flagged. Not measured here: no configured verifier launch exists in raw-evidence-index.json (its scope states full configured grading is absent), so whether OPENROUTER_API_KEY resolves and the judge authenticates at run time is unobserved. That evidence belongs to the verifier-launch row (22) and the runtime records, and this Pass is a static wiring verdict only; it is not a claim that the judge ran.
